tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password. The endpoint should validate the email and password, and reject registration if the email is already in use. The endpoint should also validate that the email is well-formed and the password meets a minimum length of 8 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the registration endpoint is called, then a new user account is created.
Given an email that is already in use, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error is returned.
Given an invalid email or password, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error is returned.

tasks.description: Store passwords using bcrypt hashing. Never store or log plaintext passwords. This task should be completed as part of the registration endpoint implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user account, when the password is stored, then it is hashed using bcrypt.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a successful login response is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then an error is returned.

tasks.description: On successful login, issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry. The frontend attaches this token to subsequent authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then it contains the user identity and an expiry.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then the token is invalidated.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for auth endpoints
tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints. These tests should ensure that the endpoints behave as expected and return the correct responses.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when the tests are run, then all tests pass.

tasks.summary: Write integration tests for auth flow
tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the full authentication flow, including registration, login, and logout. These tests should ensure that the flow behaves as expected and returns the correct responses.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when the tests are run, then all tests pass.
